extraction.Name: Vetal Valandry
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent to his allotment when he took it, but the Superintendent of the Indian Agency sent it to Martin, and they put it on record, and mailed it to him
extraction.Recorded patent: the Superintendent of the Indian Agency sent it to Martin, and they put it on record, and mailed it to him
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to the Bank of Cody, Nebraska for $1700.00; sold to Gus Salquist & Erickson for $9500.00, $5000.00 in cash, and accepted a note for $4500.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: being behind in taxes, but that he cleared this mortgage
extraction.Occupation/Income: his only income is by farming, and that he finds it hard sledding
extraction.NOTES: has rheumatism, but otherwise his health is fair; has a wife and four minor children to support; family has good health; mortgaged three quarters in 1921 and cleared the mortgage; sold in 1925; has never received any help from the County or the Government; document number 2460; notarized November 17, 1928
